title: Open Book Reading Mug, Bookworm Gift for Book Lovers, Moth and Holly Winter Coffee Mug, Librarian Teacher Gift, 11 oz Ceramic Mug
description:
A big open book with gilded pages and sprigs of holly, and a pale luna moth rising out of it into a sky of tiny gold stars. A quiet mug for winter evenings, one more chapter and a hot drink beside the lamp: a gift for bookworms, librarians, teachers and night readers. No words on the mug, just the art.

Printed and shipped by our production partner
Each mug is printed for you after you order and shipped by our print-on-demand production partner in the USA.

Details
- Material: white glossy ceramic
- Size: 11 oz (0.33 l), about 3.8 in tall and 3.2 in across, classic C-handle
- Print: full-colour sublimation, the scene sits on the front of the mug on a black background, with a sprinkle of gold stars around the sides
- Care: hand washing is recommended to keep the print bright for longer

Production and shipping
- Production: usually 2 to 5 business days
- Shipping (US): usually 3 to 7 business days after production; you get a tracking number by email when it ships

Original artwork by Duskwood Designs Co. No text on the design.

Designed with the help of digital and AI tools, and checked by hand.
